title: Letter Case Permutation
statement: Given a string of letters and digits, return every string obtained by changing the case of any letters. Digits stay fixed. Sort the result.
constraints: s consists of letters and digits
hints: Each letter has two choices. Digits have one.
A DFS that branches only on letters builds every string.

approaches.name: Iterative product
approaches.explanation: Start from the empty prefix and extend.

editorial: Walk the string. A digit is appended as itself. A letter branches into its lower and upper forms. At the end of the string, record the path. Sorting makes the list deterministic.
